# Purpose

*A living, append-only record of what has changed in the EcoCommons data audit — each catalogue update, rule change and data-quality finding, with the date, the reason and who made it. New entries go at the top.*

This is the audit's **memory**: the [Data Catalogue](prod_dataset_catalogue.qmd), [Dataset List](dataset_list.qmd) and [Rule Book](rule_book.qmd) always show the *current* state, while this log explains *how it got there*. For how the underlying data is extracted, see the [production catalogue audit](ecocommons_prod_data_audit.qmd).

------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Open findings

Items surfaced by the audit that are not yet resolved.

| Opened | Area | Finding | Status |
|:-----------|:-----------------|:------------------------------------------------|:-----------|
| 2026-10-13 | Data Catalogue | *Soil and Landscape Grid National Soil Attribute Maps - Release 2* holds **8 records**, but the `event_view` usage export counted only **7** — one layer appears to have been missed in that export. | Open — confirm which count is correct. |
| 2026-10-06 | Catalogue | **289 records sit in no collection** (the `None` orphan bucket); many products exist as a single layer. Flagged by [`DS-002`](rule_book.qmd#ds-002). | Open — triage orphans. |
| 2026-10-06 | Catalogue | **45 records are uncategorised** (≈0.08%), against the controlled vocabulary in [`MD-001`](rule_book.qmd#md-001). | Open — assign categories. |
| 2026-10-06 | Access | The non-downloadable set (`downloadable: No`) is concentrated in **WorldClim-v2.1** and **eBird** — the two biggest products. Flagged by [`DS-004`](rule_book.qmd#ds-004). | Open — explicit access decision needed. |

# How to add an entry

Append a new row to the top of the **Log** table (newest first) with the date (`YYYY-MM-DD`), the area affected, a one-line description of the change, the reason, and who made it. When a change resolves an item in **Open findings**, update that item's status and reference the log entry.
